title: OreFeller
description: A lightweight, configurable ore vein mining mod for Fabric. Supports modded ores and customizable activation.
body:
⛏️ OreFeller

OreFeller is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that allows you to mine entire ore veins in a single action.

Break one ore block, and all directly connected ores of the same type will be mined automatically. The system is designed to stay close to vanilla gameplay, keeping mining fast and satisfying without removing the need for tools or progression.

---

✨ Features

* Break connected ore veins automatically
* Designed to feel natural and survival-friendly
* Consumes tool durability for each block mined
* Only affects directly connected ore blocks (build-safe)
* Keybind support with configurable behavior
* Multiplayer-safe

---

⚙️ Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition
* Fabric (NeoForge support planned)
* Works in survival worlds
* Supports vanilla ore blocks
* May support modded ores depending on tags and compatibility

---

📦 Installation
Download the mod `.jar` and place it in your `mods` folder.
Requires Fabric (NeoForge support planned).

---

📝 Notes

* Extremely large ore veins may be limited for performance reasons
* Only directly connected ore blocks are mined
* Ore blocks placed by players may be affected if connected
